column1: # ComputerBase — AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D vs. 7800X3D, 5800X3D & Core Ultra im Test.
# Gaming-Benchmarks, Ghost of Tsushima, 720p, "Preset sehr hoch, Zusatzoptionen
# aus", native. 720p is deliberate: a CPU-scaling review removes the graphics
# card as a limit so the processors actually separate.
# Same game and SAME PRESET as the RX 9070 gpu-scaling import, which is what
# lets the cell carry both A (GPU side) and B (CPU side).
# DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, so every row here shares the one recorded test system:
#   · Ryzen 7 7800X3D — ran DDR5-5200CL30, not the DDR5-5600CL32 standard
#   · Ryzen 7 5800X3D — AM4 on DDR4-3200CL14, a different platform entirely
#   · the 9800X3D Turbo-Mode / DDR5-OC, 14900K DDR5-OC and 285K DDR5-OC rows —
#     non-stock configurations that would collide on entry id with their stock
#     counterparts, and the importer's dedupe would silently keep whichever
# RAM capacity/sticks are ComputerBase's standard kit; the article states the
# speed and timing (DDR5-5600CL32) but not the capacity.
